title: Delete answer
description: The answer of the command delete, on standard output: the state of the machine in the request's id after the request. The answer is at most 1 MiB. It has no version. The provisioner ignores a member that this schema does not define, unless the must_understand of the answer lists it.

state.description: deleting: the vendor is deleting the machine. gone: no machine with the id exists at the vendor, also when none ever did.

must_understand.description: The members of the document that the reader must understand, each as a JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) counted from the document, such as /state. List each once, at most 32. A pointer has no line feed, and writes ~ only as ~0 or ~1. Each pointer is to a member that this schema defines. The provisioner ignores a member that this schema does not define, unless must_understand lists it. It refuses an answer whose must_understand lists a pointer that it does not define, as it refuses a document that this schema refuses.
